premises.text: Once a Web3 game has traction, its game economy becomes a real economy that can crash
premises.evidence_span: as soon as you build a web 3 game Your game economy becomes a real economy

premises.text: Healthy economies require participant production plus tax-like sinks that create currency value
premises.evidence_span: the people who are participating in the economy should be able to produce in that economy

premises.text: Platform features including on-chain minigames, crafting, rewards, leaderboards, and security bots maintain healthy game economies
premises.evidence_span: we have on-chain minigames, on-chain crafting, Minecraft style

premises.text: Monetization is a monthly analytics fee plus per-interaction infrastructure charges for game projects
premises.evidence_span: we charge $1,000 per month to anyone who wants to know what's going on in an on-chain economy

value.text: Web3 games keep their on-chain economies healthy and engaging
value.evidence_span: how do I keep the economy healthy? And that's the problem that we help games to solve

causal_links.evidence_span: your biggest problem is how do I make sure my economy doesn't crash

notes: Feature list (minigames/crafting/rewards/leaderboards/bots) folded as one economy-health platform mechanism. Transaction-volume traction excluded. Pitch ends abruptly (truncated=true).
